verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents an extensive API surface (payments, transfers, billing, webhooks, refunds) plus a CLI and AgentOS/MCP that explicitly exposes API-level actions to AI agents, with role-gated OAuth and 'no money-out by default' guardrails — strong evidence of API-first design. However, several UI-only features exist (Hosted Payment Page, Drop-in Element, Payment Links, Merchant of Record beta) that are pre-built UI/checkout products rather than pure parity mappings, and Connected Account APIs are explicitly excluded from sandbox, and money-out actions are deliberately restricted by default in AgentOS, meaning not everything doable in the UI is exposed via API/agent access. Missing for 10: explicit statement or audit confirming 1:1 feature parity between UI and API (including money-out/write actions), independent verification of full write coverage beyond documented restrictions.
